env.ZZ_WARNING_1_DO_NOT_MERGE_THIS_BUILD_ENV: These two flags exist so Vercel's auto-preview of the merchant demo branch is a working demo. DEMO_HOST_ANY makes EVERY host serve the merchant dashboard, marketing site included. MOCK makes the dashboard serve invented transactions instead of real ones.
env.ZZ_WARNING_2_WHY_IT_IS_SURVIVABLE: lib/deployEnv.ts refuses both overrides on a production Vercel deployment, so previews are demos and papex.app is not. Strip this block when merging, or keep that gate. Never neither.
env.ZZ_WARNING_3_TESTS: npm test covers this (PROD GUARD + deployEnv cases). If they fail, papex.app or a real merchant's numbers are at risk.
